verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Solo 2 speaks the standards IdPs rely on for hardware-key authentication: passkeys/WebAuthn (FIDO2) and PIV. It also supports custom attestation keys, which could in principle support authenticator-restriction policies. However, nothing in the pack names Okta, Entra ID or Google Workspace, and nothing documents how an admin would enforce hardware-key-only policies with this key. Missing for 10: documented integration with Okta/Entra ID/Google Workspace, attestation/AAGUID guidance for IdP policy enforcement, enterprise deployment docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
